currentSyntaxDirection: R2 implemented and compiler-qualified the uploaded new-only ps-0.9-r3 bounded grammar with paired projection repair and independent provider acceptance. Cold recovery is verified and the exact R successor is explicitly selected. coverage.method: Read all current raw modules; rebuild the supported import graph from the composition root. Mask nested comments and string/character literals; find top-level declarations and balance binder/type delimiters to locate function-valued result headers. This is locator discovery, not a full PSC parser or acceptance test. Manually inspect the complete body, self-call binding, Nat/List child, moved type dependencies, callbacks, state and error behavior for each of the twelve chosen workers.

qualificationPlan: Review all twelve conversions and all seven guard updates before the first candidate gate; preserve names, complete types and binder order, algorithms, fuel policies, first-error behavior and wrapper APIs.

Use one native development gate to catch grammar/type/IR issues before the expensive generation sequence. Do not launch full C1/C2/C3 after each helper.

Retain exact F1/F2 change manifests and family-specific observation sections for review and rollback. Qualify their coherent combined final F source once; do not repeat a full checkpoint per worker or family without an intervening promotion or concrete unresolved risk.

Run current raw-source generation with the selected seed, same-IR checker and established runtime/iteration conformance; require C2/C3 equality of canonical source, admissions, TS and JS and separately accepted exact provider streams.
Review generated loopification and the existing shadowing/tail/evaluation fixtures; source readability alone is not evidence of a runtime speedup.
